subject: Procurement & onboarding kickoff — demo timing and stakeholder coordination

Subject: Vendor onboarding kickoff and demo — who should attend?

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the initial intro last week. Procurement at Acme would like to start the vendor onboarding conversation and see a short technical demo so we can scope the procurement timeline. The key stakeholders we need to include are:

- Procurement (me) — contract & timeline owner
- Security — Anita Shah (cc'd on follow-ups)
- Platform/Services — Tom Becker (technical lead)
- Legal (may join for contract review)

Can you propose a 45–60 minute slot next week that includes an AE overview and an SE deep-dive? We prefer mornings PST. Also please share any checklist/procurement artifacts ahead of time so Security can review.

Best,
Priya Reddy
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Corporation

Hi Priya — great to hear from you.

Thanks for outlining the stakeholders. Proposed plan:

1) 15–20m AE intro (me): business value, deployment options (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) and timeline expectations for procurement.
2) 30–40m SE deep-dive (Soojin): architecture, security controls (KMS/HSM, audit logs), and evidence for SOC2/data residency questions.
3) 10m Q&A and next steps (owners identified).

Available morning PST slots next week:
- Tues 2026-02-17 09:00–10:00 PST
- Wed 2026-02-18 08:30–09:30 PST
- Thu 2026-02-19 10:00–11:00 PST

Soojin — can you confirm availability for a technical deep-dive in any of those windows?

I'll also attach our vendor onboarding checklist and a draft SOW for your procurement/legal to start reviewing.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi all — I can do Wed 02/18 in the morning PST. If we take the 08:30–09:30 slot I suggest we split the demo into:

- 25m technical walkthrough (infrastructure, private/VPC, KMS integration, KV cache and inference runtime behavior)
- 20m compliance evidence (SOC2 artifacts, logging, sample retention policies)
- 10–15m live Q&A and follow-ups (I can bring a checklist of items Security typically asks for)

Priya — if Security wants to review anything beforehand, send it over and I’ll prep specific pointers. Also Tom — if you have a particular test case or data sensitivity scenario, flag it and I’ll include a quick perf/cost estimate.

Thanks,
